title: Freeze Window ended by Pause
description: Performance rule — a script freezes the window and later pauses. Pause/Resume Script ends the frozen state, so the window renders mid-script and the freeze loses its effect from that point on.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Freeze Window suppresses screen updates until the script ends or pauses. A Pause/Resume step therefore silently cancels the freeze: everything after the pause renders live again, including layout switches and record loops the freeze was meant to hide. The script looks optimized but is not.
rule.remediation: If the pause is intentional (user interaction), re-issue Freeze Window right after it. If the pause is a leftover debugging aid, remove it.

meta.description: Reports scripts containing an enabled Freeze Window step (id 79) followed at a later step index by an enabled Pause/Resume Script step (id 62). One finding per script; the jump marks the freeze and every subsequent pause.
